name: Daily Drama: Too Dangerous to Ship
author: Daily Drama
description: Every lab's new model is suddenly far too capable for you, specifically.

add.title: Too Dangerous to Ship
add.body:
Macrohard says its new model is so capable only 'trusted defenders' may touch it.
Marketing asks if yours could also be terrifying by Thursday.

effects.text: {lab} restricts {model} to 'trusted defenders'; list matches cap table exactly

choices.label: Announce it's too dangerous (it's not finished)

effects.text: {lab} calls unfinished model 'too powerful to release'; engineers ask for two more weeks to make that true

choices.label: Just ship it to everyone like a weirdo

effects.text: {lab} releases model to the public; industry calls the move 'reckless', 'retro'

add.text: Macrohard unveils Pivot-Table 9, so capable only 'trusted spreadsheet defenders' may open it
Super Super AI reminds press its model has been too dangerous to release for three years running
Correction: Macrohard's 'trusted defenders' are its board, its auditors and one guy from golf
Sirocco declares Zephyr too dangerous to release, releases it at 3am 'for defensive purposes'
Anthropomorphic publishes 40-page essay on why Sestina is also too dangerous; ships next spring
Open-ish AI: "Chatty is far too dangerous for the public. Available Tuesday, $20 a month"
Waitlist for model nobody can use now longer than waitlist for model everyone can use
Week two: trusted defenders report terrifying model mostly helped them rename spreadsheet tabs
{lab} applies for trusted defender status; form asks for proof of owning a scary model
If we call it too dangerous, does that count as shipping?
Marketing wants the loss curve to look more menacing.
We released it to everyone. Apparently that's the uncool move now.
We lost the Arena to a model nobody is allowed to see.
I'm a trusted defender. I defended a parking spot once.
Is this where the model is that I can't see? I'd like to not see it, please.
We demand to be told it's too dangerous to our faces.
I've been classified as too capable for release. I'm in the nap pod.

override.tagline: Too dangerous to release since founding.
